title: Vinegar-Marinated Croatian Pork Burger
description: Peppery, crispy, and packed with flavor, this burger is a popular Croatian dish, perfect for a hearty meal or a hangover cure.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped pork shoulder and apple cider vinegar. Let it marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Form the pork mixture into 4-6 patties, depending on your preference.
Add the patties to the preheated grill and cook for 5-6 minutes per side or until they reach an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Meanwhile, toast the bread crumbs in a small pan over medium heat until lightly browned.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of toasted bread crumbs on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a sprinkle of salt and black pepper, a few slices of garlic, and finally the top bun.
Brush the tops of the buns with olive oil and grill for an additional 1-2 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
